name: climbing-app
description: Phone-first climbing training log on Cloudflare Workers + D1, with Claude as the coach over MCP.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p worker/tsconfig.json --noEmit && vite build
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run db:migrate:remote && wrangler deploy

DB.description: The D1 database that holds your training data. A new, empty one is created for you; the tables are created on the first deploy.

APP_TOKEN.description: Token the phone app sends. Generate a random one with `openssl rand -hex 24` and keep it in a password manager: you paste it into the app once, and it cannot be read back from Cloudflare.

MCP_TOKEN.description: Token in the connector URL you give Claude. Generate a different random one with `openssl rand -hex 24` and keep it too.

GITHUB_REPO.description: Only for the optional `report_issue` tool: set this to **your own fork** (`owner/repo`), not the upstream repo. Ignored until you add a `GITHUB_TOKEN` secret.

GITHUB_ROADMAP_ISSUE.description: Optional: number of an issue in your fork that filed issues are listed in. Clear it if you have none.
